create.title: Share a secret
create.inputSecretPlaceholder: Paste a password, API key or private note
create.inputReadReceiptLabel: Read receipt (track when the secret is opened)
create.subtitle: Encrypted in your browser and shared as a short-lived link. Keep passwords out of email and chat for good.
create.inputOneTimeHint: The link stops working after the first view.
create.inputGenerateKeyHint: Turn off to set your own password instead.

upload.errorSelectFile: Please select a file to upload
upload.fileTooLarge: File exceeds the maximum allowed size of {{maxSize}}

display.captionDecryptionKey: Do not refresh this window as secret might be restricted to one time download.
display.inputDecryptionKeyLabel: This link doesn't include the key. Ask the sender for it and paste it below.
display.errorInvalidPasswordDetailed: That key doesn't decrypt this secret.
display.oneTimeWarning: It can be opened once. After you view it, it is deleted from the server.
display.authRequiredDescription: This secret can only be viewed by authenticated users. Please sign in to continue.
display.downloadFailedDescription: The encrypted file could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
display.viewNoteMultiple: It stays available until it expires.

error.title: This secret is no longer available
error.subtitle: It was already opened, its lifetime ran out, or the link is incomplete. Ask the sender for a new link.
error.subtitleOpenedBefore: One-time links are deleted the moment they're opened, possibly by someone else.
error.subtitleBrokenLink: The link must match exactly for decryption to work. Check that nothing was cut off.
error.subtitleExpired: Unopened secrets are deleted on schedule, after one hour up to one week.

result.title: Your link is ready
result.subtitle: Anyone with the link can open it until it expires. For extra caution, send the key through a different channel.
result.subtitleDownloadOnce: It can only be opened once, so don't open it yourself. For extra caution, send the key through a different channel.
result.receiptDescription: This page updates automatically when the secret is opened. The status is available until the secret expires.
result.receiptExpired: The secret expired before it was opened
result.receiptError: Could not check the read receipt
result.receiptListHint: You can also find it later on the Receipts page.

secret.subtitleFile: Your file was decrypted and saved to your downloads. Save it again if you need to.
secret.subtitleMessage: This page is the only copy. Copy it somewhere safe now.

delete.messageDeleted: The secret is removed from the server!
delete.dialogMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this secret?

expiration.invalid: Choose a date and time between {{min}} and {{max}} from now.
expiration.timezone: Times are in your local time zone ({{timezone}}).
expiration.hint: Unopened secrets are deleted on schedule.

readOnly.title: Secret Retrieval
readOnly.description: This instance is configured for secret retrieval only. To view a secret, you need a complete secret link.

auth.loginRequiredDescription: You must be signed in to create secrets on this server.
auth.loginUnavailable: Sign-in is currently unavailable because the server license has expired. Please contact your administrator.

request.createSubtitle: Create a secure link that lets someone send a secret to you. The reply is encrypted in their browser with a key that only this browser can unlock.
request.inputLabelHint: The label is stored unencrypted and shown to anyone who opens the request link — don't put anything sensitive in it.
request.errorCreateFailed: Could not create the secret request. Please try again.
request.resultSubtitle: Share this link with the person who should provide the secret.
request.resultLinkDescription: Anyone with this link can submit one secret to you. The link includes a key fingerprint so the recipient's browser can verify the encryption key.
request.resultKeyNotice: The private key for this request is stored in this browser only. To collect the secret from another browser, export the request from the list first.
request.listSubtitle: Requests created in this browser. Secrets are decrypted locally with the private key stored here.
request.listEmpty: No secret requests yet. Create one to receive a secret securely.
request.importDescription: Import a request export from another browser to manage it here, including its private key.
request.importDropText: Drag & drop the exported .json file here, or click to choose it
request.importError: That doesn't look like a valid request export.
request.errorFetchFailed: Could not fetch the secret from the server.
request.errorDecryptFailed: Could not decrypt the secret. The private key in this browser may not match this request. The encrypted message is shown below — save it, because the server has deleted its copy. It can be decrypted with the matching private key.
request.errorRotateFailed: Could not replace the key pair.
request.errorSubmitFailed: Could not submit the secret. Please try again.
request.revealNotice: The secret has been deleted from the server. This is the only time it will be shown — copy it somewhere safe now.
request.revealFileNotice: The file has been deleted from the server. This is the only time it is available — download it and save it somewhere safe now.

confirm.revokeMessage: The link will stop working immediately and any secret already provided will be deleted from the server. This cannot be undone.
confirm.rotateMessage: A new key pair will be generated in this browser and the public key on the server will be replaced. Links you shared earlier will fail their key verification — share the new link afterwards.
confirm.removeMessage: This only removes the request and its private key from this browser. If the request is still active on the server, revoke it instead.
confirm.clearCollectedMessage: All collected requests and their private keys are removed from this browser. The secrets were already deleted from the server when you viewed them.
confirm.purgeAllMessage: Every active request is revoked on the server — their links stop working and any secrets already provided are deleted. All private keys and tokens are then wiped from this browser. This cannot be undone.
confirm.viewMessage: The secret will be retrieved and permanently deleted from the server — this can only be done once. Make sure you are ready to copy or download it.

request.provideSubtitle: Enter the secret below. It is encrypted in your browser before it is sent — only the requester can read it.
request.provideInputPlaceholder: Enter the secret to send back...
request.provideSuccessSubtitle: The secret was encrypted and delivered. You can close this page.
request.provideFulfilledSubtitle: A secret has already been submitted for this request.
request.provideNotFoundSubtitle: This secret request has expired, been revoked, or never existed.
request.provideIntegritySubtitle: The encryption key on the server does not match the fingerprint in your link. Do not submit the secret — contact the requester.
request.errorPurgeFailed: Some requests could not be revoked on the server. They were kept in the list so you can retry.

receipts.listSubtitle: Receipts for secrets created in this browser. Each receipt shows whether — and when — the secret was opened.
receipts.listEmpty: No read receipts yet. Enable "Read receipt" when creating a secret to track when it is opened.

confirm.removeMessage: The receipt token is discarded — you will no longer be able to check whether this secret was opened.
confirm.clearAllMessage: All receipt tokens are discarded — you will no longer be able to check whether these secrets were opened.

aside.title: How it works
aside.step1Text: The key is created on this page and never sent to the server.
aside.step2Text: Send one link, or the link and key over separate channels.
aside.step3Text: Then it's deleted. Unopened secrets expire on schedule.
aside.footer: Built to secure and encrypt your messages, end to end.

generator.title: Password generator
generator.hint: Made in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
